name: Scoundrel's Greatsword

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Flaming
effects.tooltip: Flaming : This weapon is sheathed in fire. A flaming weapon deals an extra 1 to 6 points of fire damage on a successful hit.

effects.name: Anarchic
effects.tooltip: Anarchic : An anarchic weapon is chaotically aligned and infused with the power of chaos. It makes the weapon chaos-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all of lawful alignment.

flavor_text: The largest of the swords, this weapon can only be used with two hands. Used for when you just can't get enough murder and pillaging done with a smaller weapon.
tips: The Pirate Treasure Map , the 3 items from the Corsair's Cunning set, the 4 'Scoundrel's type' weapons and Brine Shaman's Staff have a chance of appearing in the end reward list of any of the Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) quests, except Guard Duty . Every third completion you will receive a complete list.
